Residential clean energy credit, Form 5695, Part I."; i5695 p. 5, Line 14 worksheet: "* Include the amount in the instructions for Schedule 8812 (Form 1040), Credit Limit Worksheet B, line 14, instead of the amount from Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 19, if the instructions for Schedule 8812 (Form 1040) direct you to complete Credit Limit Worksheet B.". Validation: the reply fails host type validation (f5695.h_credits_rce and f5695.h_credits_eehi declared NonNegDollars, "the expression does not prove non-negativity"), so triage cannot execute any line; this adjudicates the declaration (line 15 depends on h_credits_rce). By reading, as rounds 1 and 2: "claiming" read as line 15 above zero is circular (line 15 depends on line 14, which takes Credit Limit Worksheet B line 14, which this predicate decides), and through line 15 it needs every Part I answer on returns without Part I. The project tests Part I claimed with line 13 above zero.
